links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate with AI-assisted vs traditional colonoscopy in randomized trial
links.effect: ADR 34.5% with computer-aided colonoscopy vs 32.9% with traditional colonoscopy (p = 0.656); no significant difference between groups.
links.quote: The ADR (CAC:34.5% vs TC:32.9%; p = 0.656) was not significantly different between the groups.

screen.reason: Multicenter randomized controlled trial evaluating the clinical impact of computer-aided detection (CADe) during real-time colonoscopy compared to standard colonoscopy, without testing specific deployment safeguards or implementation practices.
